title: ID0409623-DC/Si-D/NO-[VfoClG] Charger limiting power with MAN bus
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charging limitation of 120kW instead of 200kW
Solution:
Update to v8.0.X
2025-02-27 Note from L2 - Very strange behaviour of DPA, when a bus SoC goes above 63% it will start charging to max power and when there are 2 charging, when one leaves, the other will start charging max power.
2025-03-17: R&D is introducing a timeout of 3mins instead of 1min for the full ramp up to occur

additional_info.subject: ID0409623-DC/Si-D/NO-[VfoClG] Charger limiting power with MAN bus CRM:00315002407
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen, good morning.
As I already mentioned to you yesterday, the R&D has given us a reply:
"In DPA FIFO-2 the waiting time for optimization will be increased from previously 1 minute to 3 minutes.
So the truck will have longer time to increase its current after the power delivery charging phase started"
This is supposed to come out in v8.0.X.
From our side, there is nothing else we can provide, what do you want to do here?
Close the ticket and I keep you updated if I can get a hotfix?
You keep the ticket?
I will wait for your feedback.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
